description: The browser softphone: the web app's Phone dialer (Messaging ▸ Phone) places and answers calls on the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx numbers from the browser. With no arguments, lists which numbers ring the browser; ringNumbers makes incoming calls to those numbers ring it (on Telnyx the number moves onto the softphone's own connection), stopRinging undoes that. The provider bills the calls. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

replaceExisting.description: Twilio: take over a number whose calls another app answers
